summary: Nora can now be present on more than one chat platform at once, and answers each message in the place it was asked.
details: Every platform she is set up for is listened to at the same time, rather than only the first one — a second platform used to connect and then sit silent.
A reply, a 👀, and a reminder all go back to the room they belong to, so a question asked in one place is never answered in front of a different group.
Her health page now lists each platform separately, and reports her as unwell if she has gone deaf on any one of them rather than only checking the first.
If she is somehow asked to speak somewhere she has no way to reach, she refuses and says so loudly instead of sending it to whichever room she can reach.

Nora now takes her own name on each platform from that platform itself, rather than from a name typed into her settings — with more than one platform, a single written-down name was always wrong for all but one of them.
Nora reacts on Discord now — the 👀 while she is thinking and the ✅/⚠️ when she is done — the same acknowledgement she already gave on Signal.

A person is identified only by something they cannot quietly change: a phone number or a user ID. A username is still written in her records so a human can read them, but it never decides who anybody is — someone renaming themselves, or taking a name someone else gave up, cannot become that person.
Nora keeps reacting after an ordinary Discord reconnect, instead of reporting herself permanently offline while working fine.
limitations: Which platforms are switched on is still an operator setting, applied at startup — turning one on or off needs a restart.
Discord itself remains off by default; this is the wiring that makes enabling it actually work, not a decision to enable it.
Operator note: the `nora_sender_id` setting under [platforms.signal] has been removed. A config file still carrying it will be refused at startup — delete the line.
Sending a file or GIF into a Discord channel is not supported yet: she reports the failure instead of posting the caption alone and calling it delivered. Signal is unaffected.
